{{Quote|Oh, the sights they'll see along the fabulous Salin! The Fire Rapids of Mazuma! The Carpastor Comet Swarm!|Hondo Ohnaka, on the passengers of the ''Salin Mariner''|<ref name="Insider144" />}}
The '''Carpastor Comet Swarm''' was an astronomical phenomenon<ref name="Insider144" /> located in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Carpastor system/Legends|Carpastor system]] of the [[Rolion sector/Legends|Rolion sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="Trans-Hydian" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated along the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]].<ref name="Insider144" />

By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="HondoDate">{{HondoOhnakaScoreDate}}</ref> the company [[Salin Excursions]] was offering luxury cruises along the Salin Corridor aboard the [[C-One liner|liner]] ''[[Salin Mariner]]'' that witnessed the Carpastor Comet Swarm. At one point, [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], the leader of a [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirate gang]] that planned to kidnap first-class passengers off the ''Salin Mariner'' in order to hold them for ransom, mentioned the Carpastor Comet Swarm as part of a tongue-in-cheek characterization of the cruise while presenting the gang's target during a briefing beforehand.<ref name="Insider144" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Carpastor Comet Swarm was mentioned in [[Jason Fry]]'s short story "[[Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 144|144th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider144" /> on [[September 3]], [[2013]].<ref name="Insider144Date">[[Star Wars Insider 143|''Star Wars Insider'' 143]]</ref> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Carpastor [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby the Carpastor Comet Swarm, in grid square Q-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
